title: Lissajous Figures
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Lissajous
learningObjectives: Explain how the parametric equations x = A sin(at + delta) and y = B sin(bt) generate a closed curve from two perpendicular oscillations
Predict the number of horizontal and vertical lobes from the ratio of the x-frequency and y-frequency slider values
Compare the figures produced by simple frequency ratios such as 1:1, 1:2, and 2:3 with those from non-integer ratios
Explain why an irrational frequency ratio produces a curve that never closes on itself
Identify the phase offset delta as the parameter that turns a 1:1 figure from a diagonal line into a circle
